description: For one perpetual on Hyperliquid (public info API): mark price, open interest (in coins and USD), funding rate, and estimated liquidation prices for longs and shorts at 5x, 10x, 20x and 50x. The estimates are formula-based from the mark price and the asset's maximum leverage, not observed positions: the public API does not show which price each trader is liquidated at. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

coin.description: Perp coin name as Hyperliquid lists it, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL
